title: 门前择牌
status: 卡牌肉鸽入口交易节点的画风概念稿，待用户评审
brief: docs/designs/焦土迷宫美术设计需求.docx
method: 内置 ImageGen 首轮人物与卡牌造型，随后扩展为横向游戏中景。

styleReference.source: 用户本轮提供的三角色画风参考

passes.aim: 人物略低于参考的写实程度，门前比较攻、防、回击三种战斗牌。
passes.prompt:
Create ONE new horizontal 16:10 concept frame for a Chinese-language 2D deckbuilding roguelike game. The location is a card-trading stall at the threshold of an immense labyrinth on a burnt plain. The moment is quiet and charged: a seasoned but hungry survivor is choosing a card for the coming expedition. The requested "combat flavor" is in functional battle gear, poised silhouettes and tactical card illustrations. This is a NON-COMBAT NODE. No fighting, enemy, monster, strike, drawn weapon, spell effect, active battle HUD, health bars or damage numbers. Exactly two people: a survivor and the human gatekeeper/merchant in the same continuous playable environment.

REFERENCE PRIORITIES:
* Image 1, the three-character lineup the user provided, is the MAIN CHARACTER ART STYLE reference, not the cast or costumes to copy. Stay close to its mature adult proportions, believable posture, weighted hanging cloth, layered wraps, and restrained indigo / bone / charcoal harmony. Make the two characters only ONE SMALL STEP less realistic than those drawings. Keep the nose and eyes defined and heads normal sized; consolidate hair into several thoughtful locks, keep two or three large folds for each garment, remove fine cracks, pores and all-over surface noise. Matte clean local colors, subtle soft transitions in a cheek or sleeve and quiet colored edges. A finished 2D animated videogame character illustration, convincingly shaped, not toy-like, chibi or a smooth 3D figurine. No oil painting, all-over brush marks, canvas grain, black-ink outlines, photographic detail or comic hatching. Do not reproduce the masked humanoid, armored giant, fork, or weapons from Image 1.
* Image 2 provides the setting's existing color-block shape language ONLY: colossal offset blue-gray and muted violet wall planes, a deep narrow walkable opening, and a pale worn sill leading a single bend into darkness. Keep those few broad shapes and the ash slope quieter and simpler than the figures. Use the ORIGINAL cool gate / warm card contrast. Recompose at a medium-wide in-game distance rather than copying the old enlarged foreground characters.

Place the standing survivor left of center, at around x=35-39%, full body occupying 45-50% of the picture height, and the seated keeper right of center at x=70%, with the low table, its legs, and stool fully visible. They are only one step apart at the stall; perspective lets us read the cards and the clear path between and behind them into the door. The survivor has short dark hair, a slate-indigo asymmetrical short mantle over a fitted worn ash-ochre travel jacket, light bone-colored forearm guard, bound boots and an obviously collapsed ration pouch. A distinctive functional RECTANGULAR DECK CASE at the near hip holds several slightly staggered cream card edges. Quiet alert stance, legs carrying weight, hands loose, gaze on the choices. With the near hand loosely tipped toward the table they compare one old defensive card from their own deck; the printed bracer icon is seen, and their hand does NOT attack or present a weapon.

The gatekeeper is a different original human with a bare, slightly weathered middle-aged face, slow lowered lids and broad gray-violet sleeves; no mask. He sits low and square, looking at the playing card he is carefully straightening. Tiny shaded amber lamp on the far side warms his fingertips and the clean folded cloth. The TABLETOP is tilted enough toward us to show exactly THREE DISTINCT face-up game cards arranged in a shallow fan, with an unobtrusive corner cost pip and clear large original pictograms: a forward palm impact in dull clay red (attack), crossed protective bracers in desaturated blue-green (guard), and a bracer with a curling-outward return arrow in ochre (counter). Their game-card proportions, slight clipped corners, pale faces and differing emblems must be unmistakable at thumbnail size. The counter card is slid slightly toward the survivor for comparison, the gatekeeper's two fingers carefully clear of its central printed icon. If using lettering, only the tiny title 回击 on the offered card; prioritize legible pictograms over text. The correspondence between survivor's worn guard card and the offered counter card gives a real reason to consider this choice. No full screen shop menu, large floating card choice panels or dashboard. Draw the gatekeeper's cloth, standing protective traveler, deck case, and card stall as intentional game assets in a shared perspective; both have small integrated contact shadows under the same cool skylight. Strong readable design at game scale, muted but not washed out, a little directional tension in the scarf and threshold light, plenty of breathing room in the architecture. Full bleed, no signature or border.

passes.aim: 重排门前留白，将求生者缩至约四至五成画高，保留对牌手势。
passes.prompt: Make a final WIDER 16:10 playable-camera concept image of the exact quiet card-selection moment in IMAGE 1. IMAGE 1 is the authority for all character designs, anatomy, faces, indigo and ivory clothing weight, subdued clean illustrated styling, arm guard, worn card deck case, readable three attack / guard / counter card pictograms, the old card in the traveler's hand, stall and warm little lamp. IMAGE 2 is provided ONLY to show what a pulled-back game camera is and how to simplify the broad gate architecture; DO NOT use the simplified faces, costume styles, close-down or far-apart positioning of the people in IMAGE 2. A new game-camera frame halfway between the near crop in Image 1 and the open long shot in Image 2, favoring the smaller game scale but holding the two characters one step apart at the SAME stall. Draw both people at 68% of their size in image 1 on the same final canvas size: standing head at 28–30% from the top and feet at 76–78%. Keep that person's height at or below ONE HALF of the frame. The seated keeper, seated feet, stool, table legs and cards scale with the traveler, both still fully and equally grounded. Extend the setting naturally to fill framing; the new open margins must be drawn, not a border. Preserve the character style in IMAGE 1: mature, slightly simplified like matte animated game illustration, clean local colors and soft facial gradations, layered indigo cloth and bone-ivory bracer, no oil painting, black ink outline, photorealism or surface noise. Keep first-person choice readable even at game scale: the player holds a worn bracer card, the keeper has precisely THREE forward-facing large playing cards on sloped cloth, the shapes are a palm impact, crossed protection, and a bracer with counter arrow; title 回击 only if legible. A tense prepared stance, NOT combat: no enemies, looming figures, attacks, fighting effects, weapons, hand-of-cards HUD, combat numbers, timers, additional objects or figures. The entrance is still a physical doorway between ancient violet walls with a single blind inner bend. Cool skylight unifies matte ash slope, quiet figures and graphic flat broad wall planes; intimate warm accent on the hand, cream cards and stall. Deliver a single clean full-bleed game scene.
